2026_04_LA_PHI.headline: The Rams carry a short-week recovery challenge into Philadelphia
2026_04_LA_PHI.paragraph1: The Rams head east after a 30-26 Sunday night loss in Denver, giving Sean McVay’s group a recovery and preparation challenge before facing Philadelphia. Los Angeles needs its protection and run game to keep the Eagles from turning the matchup into a series of obvious passing downs, while Philadelphia can pressure the Rams by controlling the line of scrimmage and creating explosive opportunities off play action. The Rams’ defense must tackle efficiently in space and prevent the Eagles from turning manageable gains into drive-extending plays.
2026_04_LA_PHI.model_rationale: Travel and recovery add stress for Los Angeles, making protection and early-down efficiency especially important against a Philadelphia team capable of controlling tempo at home.
